text:
Fixed `TLRUCache` refresh behavior.

Root cause: overwriting a key created a new expiration item without marking the old heap entry as removed, so the old deadline could later evict the refreshed value.

The update now marks the previous expiration entry as removed after successfully storing the new value, allowing reassigned keys to remain valid until their new deadline.

final_text:
Fixed `TLRUCache` refresh behavior.

Root cause: overwriting a key created a new expiration item without marking the old heap entry as removed, so the old deadline could later evict the refreshed value.

The update now marks the previous expiration entry as removed after successfully storing the new value, allowing reassigned keys to remain valid until their new deadline.
